senses.gloss:
mfn. (-गः-गी-गं)
Serpent, serpentine, relating or belonging to a snake.
n. (-गं)
The constellation Aśleṣā.
E.
उरग a snake, and अण् affix; a serpent is the regent of this constellation.

mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्री-भ्रं)
Belonging to, &c. a sheep.
m. (-भ्रः)
A coarse woollen blanket.
n. (-भ्र)
1 Mutton, the flesh of sheep.
2 Woollen cloth.
E.
उरभ्र a sheep, अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
A flock of sheep.
E.
उरभ्र, and वुञ् affix of multitude.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to, produced by, &c. sheep.
m. (-कः)
A shepherd.
E.
उरभ्र a sheep, and ठञ् aff.

mf. (-सः-सी)
A legitimate child, i. e. by a wife of the same tribe.
E.
उरस् the best, and अण् affix; the best of the twelve sons; also उरस्य and औरस्य.
